title: Kiosk self-rebooted after auto-update onto stock kernel: no touch (ipts missing)
description:
2026-11-02: touch dead on the kiosk since the Nov 1 13:37 self-reboot. NOT the kd-2i0 stuck-IPTS bug: the machine booted the stock Fedora kernel 7.2.13-300.fc45.x86_64, which has no ipts driver (the module only exists in the kernel-surface packages), so there is no touch device and no iptsd instance at all.

Timeline (from the kiosk journal):
- Nov 1 13:30: dnf5-automatic.timer ran (upgrade_type=security); 34 upgrades incl. stock kernel 7.2.13-300.
- Nov 1 ~13:31: Fedora kernel-install hooks ran: 20-grub.install set tmp_saved_entry=<stock BLS id>; the linux-surface-default-watchdog fired twice (13:31:23, 13:31:56) and set saved_entry=<surface BLS id>; 95-set-boot-entry later applied tmp_saved_entry, overwriting saved_entry back to the stock kernel. Last write won: stock.
- Nov 1 13:32:10: dnf5-automatic scheduled a reboot (reboot = when-needed in /etc/dnf/automatic.conf; default reboot_command is 'shutdown -r +5').
- Nov 1 13:37:10: kiosk rebooted itself; 13:37:23 booted 7.2.13-300 (stock). All boots Oct 26 - Nov 1 had been 7.2.12-1.surface.

Root cause of the default flip: Fedora's kernel-install makes each newly installed kernel the default (UPDATEDEFAULT=yes in /etc/sysconfig/kernel); the linux-surface watchdog only rewrites saved_entry and loses the race inside the kernel-install transaction. Combined with the automatic self-reboot, the kiosk came up on a kernel without touch.

Fix (run as root on the kiosk; script /tmp/kiosk-touch-fix.sh; log /var/tmp/kiosk-touch-fix.log):
1. grubby --set-default=/boot/vmlinuz-7.2.12-1.surface.fc45.x86_64 and clear tmp_saved_entry - immediate default fixed.
2. UPDATEDEFAULT=no in /etc/sysconfig/kernel - new kernel installs no longer change the boot default.
3. reboot = never in /etc/dnf/automatic.conf - the kiosk no longer reboots itself after updates.
4. systemctl reboot - back on the Surface kernel; touch to be confirmed by Bob.

Follow-ups: consider a deliberate move to kernel-surface 7.2.14-1.surface later (the watchdog will move the default then); stock kernels stay installed as a manual fallback.
notes: 2026-11-02 10:10: fix script staged at kiosk:/tmp/kiosk-touch-fix.sh (md5 verified); Bob approved; he runs 'ssh -t kiosk@surface "sudo bash /tmp/kiosk-touch-fix.sh"' (kiosk sudo needs a password; only touch-reset is NOPASSWD). Script log -> /var/tmp/kiosk-touch-fix.log. After reboot: verify uname -r is 7.2.12-1.surface.fc45, iptsd@dev-hidraw2 active, IPTS device present; Bob taps to confirm.
close_reason: Fixed and verified 2026-11-02 10:22. Kiosk back on 7.2.12-1.surface.fc45: saved_entry was the stock 7.2.13-300 entry before the fix and is the surface entry after; UPDATEDEFAULT=no; dnf5-automatic reboot=never. iptsd@dev-hidraw2 active; IPTS + IPTSD virtual touchscreen devices present; Bob confirmed touch works and will monitor through the day. kd-2i0 stays open for the separate stuck-IPTS class. Fix log: kiosk:/var/tmp/kiosk-touch-fix.log
